verdict.rationale: Clerk's own materials say it manages the full session lifecycle, including session revocation and per-device sign-out. The docs describe short-lived JWT session tokens, which implies expiry and refresh. However, there is no documentation of configurable session expiry, of the refresh mechanism, or of a Backend API call that immediately revokes a compromised session server-side; revocation is shown only as a marketing claim and a profile-UI sign-out. Missing for 10: documented configurable session expiry/lifetime settings, documented token refresh behavior, a programmatic server-side revocation endpoint with immediacy guarantees, and independent corroboration of revocation working.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage session lifecycle — expiry, refresh, and immediate server-side revocation of a compromised session

citations.quote: Clerk manages the full session lifecycle, including critical security functionality like active device monitoring and session revocation
